name: W25Q128JV data flash
desc: 16 MB SPI NOR flash (JEDEC EF 40 18) on SPI_Master0 (0x140a0000, bus index 0 of the SSI base table at 0x030ada00), chip select bit-banged on GPIOA bit 18 (0x12, active low; gpio_clear_output_bit 0x0002c544 / gpio_set_output_bit 0x0002c500). Standard single SPI, 3-byte addresses, 256-byte pages, 4 KB sectors. Holds per-unit data (calibration page): never erase or program it without a verified backup of the same radio. Not to be confused with the program flash (gd25q80.rdl, on the LCSFC) or the SD card on SPI_Master1 (chip select GPIO 0x17), whose corpus functions are misleadingly named (sdcard_spi_probe_and_init, renamed 2026-10-11 from spi_nor_flash_probe_and_identify; 0x03066ae0 is an SD SPI-mode init: CMD0/8/55/41/58/16) and spi_sdcard_block_write_dispatch (formerly spi_flash_write_erase_dispatch, 0x03066d24; an SD block writer).

blocks.name: Status registers
blocks.desc: Selected by opcode, not by address. Non-volatile bits are written with 06h + 01h/31h/11h; their volatile copies with 50h + 01h/31h/11h (lost at power-off). Reserved bits are omitted. The stock firmware reads only SR1 bit 0 and never writes any status register of this chip.

blocks.name: Identification
blocks.desc: Read-only values returned by an opcode (wire_addr). The three 256-byte security registers (48h/42h/44h at addresses 0x001000/0x002000/0x003000) are memory, not registers, and are not described here.

blocks.name: Instruction set
blocks.desc: One pseudo-register per opcode at offset = opcode. Frame notation: A = 3 address bytes (A23-A0), D = data, dummy = don't-care byte. Write, program and erase instructions must end on a byte boundary or are ignored; all but 05h/35h/15h and 75h are ignored while BUSY.

registers.name: Status Register-1
registers.desc: Read with 05h (wire_addr), written with wr_cmd. Factory default 0x00.
registers.wr_cmd: 01h after 06h (non-volatile bits) or after 50h (volatile copies); a second data byte after 01h also writes SR2
registers.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1 Figure 4a, PDF p.14; 8.2.4-8.2.5, PDF p.26-28
registers.fw_reads: 0x0002b83c spi_flash_wait_wip: sends 05h, reads one byte, tests bit 0 only (andi 1 at 0x0002b87e).

fields.name: BUSY
fields.desc: Erase/write in progress. Status only.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.1 (first of two 7.1.1 headings), PDF p.14
fields.fw_reads: 0x0002b83c spi_flash_wait_wip polls this bit after every 02h (call at 0x0002b8f6) and every 20h (call at 0x0002b9f2), up to 1400 times (0xaf<<3) with a delay (0x0002e0d8) between reads; a timeout falls through silently.

fields.name: WEL
fields.desc: Write enable latch: set by 06h, cleared by 04h and at the end of every program/erase/status write. Status only.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.2, PDF p.14
fields.fw_writes: Never read; set indirectly by the 06h that 0x0002b8a8 and 0x0002b9b4 send before each 02h/20h.

fields.name: BP
fields.desc: Block protect BP2:BP0 (S4:S2). Non-volatile (volatile copy writable). Factory default 0 = nothing protected. Interpreted with SEC, TB, CMP when WPS = 0 (tables 7.1.8/7.1.9).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.3, PDF p.14; protection tables p.19-20

fields.name: TB
fields.desc: Top (0) / bottom (1) protect. Non-volatile (volatile copy writable). Factory default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.4, PDF p.15

fields.name: SEC
fields.desc: Sector (1, 4 KB granules) / block (0, 64 KB granules) protect. Non-volatile (volatile copy writable). Default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.5, PDF p.15; bit position from Figure 4a, PDF p.14

fields.name: SRP
fields.desc: Status register protect; with SRL and /WP selects software / hardware / power-supply lock-down / OTP protection of the status registers. Non-volatile (volatile copy writable). Factory default 0 (software protection).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.1 (second 7.1.1 heading, SRP/SRL), PDF p.16; bit position from Figure 4a, PDF p.14

registers.name: Status Register-2
registers.desc: Read with 35h (wire_addr), written with wr_cmd. Power-up value on the DM-32UV's part (-IQ/-JQ) is 0x02: QE is factory-fixed to 1, see QE.
registers.wr_cmd: 31h after 06h (non-volatile) or 50h (volatile); or the second data byte of 01h
registers.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1 Figure 4b, PDF p.17; 8.2.4-8.2.5, PDF p.26-28

fields.name: SRL
fields.desc: Status register lock (power-supply lock-down when 1; cleared by a power cycle). Volatile/non-volatile writable.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.1 (second heading), PDF p.16; Figure 4b, PDF p.17

fields.name: QE
fields.desc: Quad enable. Factory-fixed 1 on -IQ/-JQ parts, 0 on -IM/-JM. The radio's part reads JEDEC EF 40 18, which the datasheet assigns to -IQ/-JQ, so the reset value here is 1; the bit itself has not been read on a radio.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.4 (second heading), PDF p.17; device ID table 8.1.1, PDF p.22
fields.hw_reads: Real radio: 9Fh on chip select GPIOA 0x12 returned EF 40 18 (= -IQ/-JQ per 8.1.1). SR2 never read directly.

fields.name: LB1
fields.desc: Security register 1 lock (OTP: once 1, security register 1 is read-only forever). Factory default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.3 (second heading), PDF p.17

fields.name: LB2
fields.desc: Security register 2 lock (OTP). Factory default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.3 (second heading), PDF p.17

fields.name: LB3
fields.desc: Security register 3 lock (OTP). Factory default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.3 (second heading), PDF p.17

fields.name: CMP
fields.desc: Complement protect: inverts the area selected by SEC/TB/BP. Non-volatile (volatile copy writable). Default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.6, PDF p.15

fields.name: SUS
fields.desc: Erase/program suspended (set by 75h, cleared by 7Ah or power cycle). Status only.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.2 (second heading), PDF p.17

registers.name: Status Register-3
registers.desc: Read with 15h (wire_addr), written with wr_cmd. Factory default 0x60.
registers.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1 Figure 4c, PDF p.18; 8.2.4-8.2.5, PDF p.26-28

fields.name: WPS
fields.desc: Write protect selection: 0 = SEC/TB/BP/CMP scheme, 1 = individual block/sector locks (36h/39h/3Dh/7Eh/98h, which power up all-locked). Factory default 0.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.5 (second heading), PDF p.18; factory default stated in 6.x write protection, PDF p.13

fields.name: DRV
fields.desc: Output driver strength DRV1:DRV0 for reads. Figure 4c labels S21 'DRV2'; the text and table name it DRV0 (datasheet typo; the text wins).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 7.1.6 (second heading), PDF p.18

registers.name: JEDEC ID
registers.desc: Returned by 9Fh as three bytes, manufacturer first. Read on the real radio; the stock firmware never sends 9Fh.
registers.hw_reads: Real radio: 9Fh on chip select GPIOA 0x12 returned EF 40 18.

fields.name: CAPACITY
fields.desc: Capacity (18h = 128 Mbit).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 8.1.1, PDF p.22

fields.name: MEMORY_TYPE
fields.desc: Memory type (40h = -IQ/-JQ; 70h = -IM/-JM).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 8.1.1, PDF p.22

fields.name: MF
fields.desc: Manufacturer ID (Winbond = EFh).
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 8.1.1, PDF p.22

registers.name: Unique ID
registers.desc: Factory-programmed 64-bit serial number, returned by 4Bh after four dummy bytes. Per device: no value is recorded in this repo. The stock firmware never sends 4Bh to this chip, so it cannot be what binds firmware to a unit.
registers.fw_reads: Never: no 4Bh is sent by any stock function (see the file header for the method).

fields.name: UID
fields.desc: UID63:UID0, MSB first.
fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 8.2.26, PDF p.50

registers.name: Write Status Register-1
registers.desc: Frame: 01h S7-S0 [S15-S8]. After 06h writes the non-volatile bits (BUSY during tW); after 50h the volatile copies. A second data byte writes SR2 too. Can permanently set LB1-3 and lock the status registers: OTP risk.
registers.fw_writes: Never sent to this chip by stock firmware.

fields.ds_ref: W25Q128JV Rev F, 8.1.2-8.1.3 (Instruction Set Tables 1-2), PDF p.23-24

registers.name: Page Program
registers.desc: Frame: 06h, then 02h A D1..D256. Programs 1-256 bytes within one 256-byte page (bytes past the page end wrap to its start). Erased bits only go 1 -> 0.
registers.fw_writes: ONLY 0x0002b8a8 spi_flash_page_program_raw: 06h (0x0002b8b2), then 02h built at 0x0002b8b8 with the shadow address 0x0003869c, sent at 0x0002b8e0, data at 0x0002b8ec, then 05h polling. Reached only through 0x0002b900 spi_flash_program_pagesplit (splits at the 256-byte page boundary). Callers of 0x0002b900: flash_page_tag_write 0x0300f2fc, mutex_guarded_param_dispatch_1/2/3 0x0300f7ac/0x03010680/0x03010818, FUN_0300f7dc, flash_block_write 0x0300f878, flash_field_write_cached 0x0300fa28, flash_page_read_modify_write 0x0300fb58, flash_record_commit_3field 0x0300fda4, flash_record_commit_4field 0x030100a8, channel_bitmap_bit_clear 0x03010558, spi_flash_log_append_2byte 0x030105d0, spi_flash_dual_log_reset_with_marker_scan 0x030106b4, flash_write_split_across_page_boundary 0x03010848, channel_list_compact_and_delete_entry 0x03010978, flash_dual_range_invalidate 0x03010b40, tx_contact_index_rewrite_both_blocks 0x03034624, quick_contact_slot_bitmask_mark 0x03034834, contact_edit_save_flow2 0x030350c4, flash_pagesplit_write_with_split_markers 0x030611d4, channel_bitmap_flash_rebuild 0x03061b0c, gps_log_record_append_compact 0x03062d2c, flash_block1_write_zero_word_tagged 0x03062e90, and 0x0002ba5c spi_flash_write_chunk_pagesplit (callers: channel_list_compact_and_delete_entry, codeplug_factory_defaults_write 0x03032434 (17 sites), quick_contact_slot_bitmask_mark, contact_edit_save_flow2, channel_bitmap_flash_rebuild, and 0x0002baac spi_flash_write_multi_sector, whose only caller is the CPS write path serial_protocol_vframe_command_loop_variant at 0x0302a6c0).

registers.name: Sector Erase (4 KB)
registers.desc: Frame: 06h, then 20h A. Erases the 4 KB sector containing A to FFh (tSE). The only erase the stock firmware uses on this chip.
registers.fw_writes: ONLY 0x0002b9b4 spi_flash_cmd_sector_erase_raw: 06h (0x0002b9ba), then 20h built at 0x0002b9c0 with the shadow address 0x0003869c, sent at 0x0002b9e8, then 05h polling (0x0002b9f2). Its only caller is 0x0002b9fc (renamed 2026-10-11 from spi_flash_read_at to spi_flash_sector_erase; it ERASES sector N: shadow = N<<12, then 0x0002b9b4). Callers of 0x0002b9fc: flash_block_id_resolve 0x0300f364, spi_flash_pending_update_scan_and_invalidate 0x0300f3d0 (4 sites), flash_block_id_resolve_helper1 0x0300f5b4 (2, one with sector 0xff), flash_block_id_resolve_helper2 0x0300f6c0, flash_mutex_guarded_op 0x0300f700, spi_flash_dual_log_reset_with_marker_scan 0x030106b4 (3), channel_list_compact_and_delete_entry 0x03010978 (2), flash_dual_range_invalidate 0x03010b40 (2), codeplug_factory_defaults_write 0x03032434 (17 sites: physical sectors 0x04 0x06 0x0a 0x0b 0x0f 0x10 0x11 0x42 0x43 0x44 0x5c 0x65 0x66 0x67 plus three computed from registers), flash_pagesplit_write_with_split_markers 0x030611d4 (2), channel_bitmap_flash_rebuild 0x03061b0c (2), gps_log_record_append_compact 0x03062d2c, flash_block1_write_zero_word_tagged 0x03062e90, and spi_flash_write_multi_sector 0x0002baac at 0x0002baf4 (the CPS write path erases each following sector its write crosses into; the first sector is not erased by it).
